reason: Contains the mnemonic covergroups and bin definitions mentioned in the report; the illegal mnemonic sampling happens here when quoted bin names no longer match unquoted sampled values.

A macro include file is the most probable place for DEF_MNEM_BIN; the regression is specifically caused by a macro expansion changing the bin literal format.
May generate or carry the mnemonic string values passed into coverage sampling; if the fix requires quoting at the source, this is a candidate for adapting the sampled mnemonic representation.
If coverage sampling is driven from the instruction monitor, this is a likely caller of the coverage sample function and may need to pass a string format compatible with the quoted bins.
